entries.name: no-n-plus-one
entries.description: Detect and prevent N+1 query patterns in database access code

entries.name: consistent-naming
entries.description: Enforce consistent naming conventions across the codebase for variables, functions, classes, and files

entries.name: secure-logging
entries.description: Log security events properly without leaking sensitive data like passwords, tokens, PII, or credit card numbers

entries.name: no-secrets-in-code
entries.description: Prevent hardcoded secrets, API keys, tokens, and passwords from being committed to the codebase

entries.name: xss-prevention
entries.description: Prevent cross-site scripting by enforcing output encoding, CSP headers, and safe DOM manipulation

entries.name: secure-error-handling
entries.description: Handle errors securely without leaking stack traces, internal paths, database details, or system information to users

entries.name: secure-api-design
entries.description: Design APIs securely with rate limiting, proper CORS, request validation, and protection against common API attacks

entries.name: secure-file-handling
entries.description: Handle file uploads, downloads, and path operations securely to prevent path traversal, arbitrary file access, and malicious uploads

entries.name: sql-injection-prevention
entries.description: Prevent SQL injection by enforcing parameterized queries and banning string concatenation in database operations

entries.name: secure-dependencies
entries.description: Manage third-party dependencies securely: pin versions, audit for vulnerabilities, and minimize attack surface

entries.name: authentication-best-practices
entries.description: Enforce secure authentication patterns: password hashing, session management, MFA support, and token handling

entries.name: command-injection-prevention
entries.description: Prevent OS command injection and code injection by avoiding shell execution with user input

entries.name: cryptography-best-practices
entries.description: Use cryptography correctly: strong algorithms, proper key management, and secure random number generation

entries.name: input-validation
entries.description: Always validate and sanitize user input at system boundaries to prevent injection attacks

entries.name: authorization-access-control
entries.description: Enforce proper authorization checks, role-based access control, and principle of least privilege across all endpoints

entries.name: general-code-review
entries.description: A lightweight checklist for consistent code reviews: readability, tests, and security
